name: Hag’s Familiar
body:
You pour your soul magic into a familiar rather than an object.

Prerequisite(s): soul focus class ability, paragon hag level 1st, possess a familiar.

Benefit(s): Instead of a soul focus object, your soul pool is stored in your familiar. You have access to your soul points as long as your familiar is alive and within arm’s reach.

Special: Your paragon hag levels now count towards improving your familiar as though paragon hag granted a familiar class ability.
